title: Encoded PowerShell command executed on WORKSTATION6 as SYSTEM
summary: A base64-encoded PowerShell command was executed as SYSTEM via cmd.exe, containing code to disable Script Block Logging and bypass AMSI, and attempting to download and execute payloads from external IP 10.10.10.5. This is consistent with T1059.001 and T1027 MITRE techniques.
evidence: Decoded PowerShell command disables Script Block Logging and bypasses AMSI
Launched from cmd.exe as parent process

recommended_actions.action: Block outbound connections to IP 10.10.10.5 at firewall
Collect full PowerShell transcript and process memory from WORKSTATION6
Investigate origin of cmd.exe parent process and user account

title: Malicious service 'Updater' executes encoded PowerShell on WORKSTATION6
summary: The 'Updater' service on WORKSTATION6 was installed and immediately executed a PowerShell command with -enc flag, which decoded to attempts to disable script block logging, bypass AMSI, and download/run code from external IP. This occurred seconds after user pgustavo logged on from 172.18.39.5, indicating likely remote service execution and defense evasion.
evidence: Service install event on WORKSTATION6 by pgustavo launching cmd.exe then powershell.exe with -enc flag
Decoded PowerShell command attempts to disable ScriptBlock logging and bypass AMSI
Decoded command downloads code from http://10.10.10.5 and executes it
Source IP 172.18.39.5 is internal company network range
User pgustavo is domain user (lab) normally on WORKSTATION5
related_to_prior: Related to ALERT-001: both involve encoded PowerShell execution on WORKSTATION6

recommended_actions.action: Terminate 'Updater' service and remove malicious payload
Investigate pgustavo account for unauthorized logon and activity
Reset credentials for pgustavo if compromise confirmed
Review other hosts for similar encoded PowerShell patterns

title: C2 Beacon on WORKSTATION6 connecting to external IP
summary: On WORKSTATION6, an encoded PowerShell command (-enc) was executed as SYSTEM, disabling script block logging and AMSI, then connecting to external IP 10.10.10.5:80. The IP is flagged as suspicious (private but outside company network). This is part of the same attack chain as ALERT-001 and ALERT-002, where a malicious 'Updater' service initiated the encoded PowerShell execution that disabled security controls and established C2 communication.
evidence: Encoded PowerShell command (-enc) executed as SYSTEM on WORKSTATION6 at 16:16:57
Command decoded to disable script block logging and bypass AMSI
Command contacts URL http://10.10.10.5 for downloads
IP 10.10.10.5 rated suspicious - private address outside company network
Process chain: services.exe → cmd.exe → powershell.exe (with -enc) → C2 connection
Part of attack chain with ALERT-001 (encoded command) and ALERT-002 (malicious 'Updater' service)
whoami.exe executed 19 seconds later confirming active shell access
related_to_prior: Continuation of same attack chain as ALERT-001 and ALERT-002 on WORKSTATION6 - the malicious 'Updater' service (ALERT-002) likely initiated the encoded PowerShell execution that established C2 beacon to 10.10.10.5

recommended_actions.action: Terminate any ongoing processes connected to 10.10.10.5
Restore script block logging and AMSI if disabled
Block 10.10.10.5 at perimeter and review all connections to this IP
Collect full memory dump and forensic evidence from WORKSTATION6
